elements.requirement: Subject to regulation 26A and paragraphs (3) and (5), a worker is entitled in each leave year to a period of additional leave determined in accordance with paragraph (2).

elements.requirement: A worker is entitled to 0.8 weeks of additional leave in any leave year beginning on or after 1st October 2007 but before 1st April 2008.

elements.requirement: A worker is entitled in any leave year beginning before 1st October 2007 to a proportion of 0.8 weeks of additional leave equivalent to the proportion of the year beginning on 1st October 2007 which would have elapsed at the end of that leave year.
elements.quote: in any leave year beginning before 1st October 2007, a proportion of 0.8 weeks equivalent to the proportion of the year beginning on 1st October 2007 which would have elapsed at the end of that leave year

elements.quote: in any leave year beginning after 1st April 2008 but before 1st April 2009, 0.8 weeks and a proportion of another 0.8 weeks equivalent to the proportion of the year beginning on 1st April 2009 which would have elapsed at the end of that leave year

elements.requirement: A worker is entitled to 1.6 weeks of additional leave in any leave year beginning on or after 1st April 2009.
elements.quote: in any leave year beginning on or after 1st April 2009, 1.6 weeks

elements.requirement: A worker’s leave year begins for the purposes of regulation 13A on the same date as the worker’s leave year begins for the purposes of regulation 13.
elements.quote: A worker’s leave year begins for the purposes of this regulation on the same date as the worker’s leave year begins for the purposes of regulation 13

elements.requirement: Where the date on which a worker’s employment begins is later than the date on which his first leave year begins, the additional leave to which the worker is entitled in that leave year is a proportion of the period applicable under paragraph (2) equal to the proportion of that leave year remaining on the date on which his employment begins.
elements.quote: Where the date on which a worker’s employment begins is later than the date on which his first leave year begins, the additional leave to which he is entitled in that leave year is a proportion of the period applicable under paragraph (2) equal to the proportion of that leave year remaining on the date on which his employment begins

elements.requirement: Leave to which a worker is entitled under regulation 13A may be taken in instalments.

elements.requirement: Leave to which a worker is entitled under regulation 13A may not be replaced by a payment in lieu except where the worker’s employment is terminated, where the leave is an entitlement that arises under paragraph (2)(a), (b) or (c), or where the leave is an entitlement to 0.8 weeks that arises under paragraph (2)(d) in respect of that part of the leave year which would have elapsed before 1st April 2009.
elements.quote: it may not be replaced by a payment in lieu except where— (a) the worker’s employment is terminated; or (b) the leave is an entitlement that arises under paragraph (2)(a), (b) or (c); or (c) the leave is an entitlement to 0.8 weeks that arises under paragraph (2)(d) in respect of that part of the leave year which would have elapsed before 1st April 2009

elements.requirement: A relevant agreement may provide for any leave to which a worker is entitled under regulation 13A to be carried forward into the leave year immediately following the leave year in respect of which it is due.
elements.quote: A relevant agreement may provide for any leave to which a worker is entitled under this regulation to be carried forward into the leave year immediately following the leave year in respect of which it is due

elements.requirement: Where, as a result of taking a period of statutory leave in any leave year, a worker is unable to take some or all of the annual leave to which the worker is entitled in that leave year under regulation 13A, the worker is entitled to carry forward such untaken leave into the following leave year.
elements.quote: Where, as a result of taking a period of statutory leave in any leave year, a worker is unable to take some or all of the annual leave to which the worker is entitled in that leave year under this regulation, the worker is entitled to carry forward such untaken leave into the following leave year
